figure: supplementary benchmark samples (custom sets): shadow_v1 types A / B and the synthetic low light of bench2d v2; GT 2D keypoints
rule: licence-clean images only: an open CC licence and a credited author; excluded: the challenging-pose stock sheets, the real dark photos, shadow us01-us04, EgoStandard and user-video frames

shadow.candidates: shadow_v1 images from Open Images V7, Openverse (Flickr) or Wikimedia Commons, not borderline, with annotated hands; one list per type (A: shadow on the hand, B: hand next to its own cast shadow)
shadow.pick_rule: visual pick from the per-type candidate sheets: a clear shadow on the hand (A) or the hand next to its own cast shadow (B), no dominant face

dark.candidates: bench2d v2 COCO val2017 images (synthetic low-light copy, bench/bench2d/make_dark.py --level dark) whose COCO / Flickr licence id is 4, 5, 7 or 8 (CC BY, CC BY-SA, no known copyright restriction, US Government work); hands with a box side >= 80 px and >= 15 visible joints; images with >= 1 such hand
dark.check: in the fixed random order: a single clearly visible hand, plausible labels, no dominant or child face, a Flickr page that still shows author and licence; and (stricter check after review) one open or clearly articulated hand with all five fingers readable

decisions.reason: stricter check: implausible GT (a fist with vertical finger chains)
